spec.trigger: R640 OS hang followed by A1 WireGuard boot ordering failure and loss of Windows host SSH management paths
rootCauses: A1 wg-quick started before its 10.181.22.147 preferred source address was available
A1 Windows OpenSSH Server was absent
Windows OpenSSH capability installation failed with 0x80240438 because the feature source was unreachable
A1 and B1 Windows hosts had no active ZeroTier interface, so legacy direct Windows addresses timed out
repairs: Validated the declared R640 public network authority before restoring A1 WireGuard
Restored the A1-R640 WireGuard session and etcd quorum
Installed the reviewed SYSTEM control-plane watchdog on B1, then A1
Recovered A1 OpenSSH from B1's matching standalone Microsoft OpenSSH installation without copying host keys
Installed per-host Administrator public keys with SYSTEM and Administrators-only ACLs
Changed operator access to WSL ZeroTier jump hosts followed by the Windows LAN endpoint
